source:
@@U00822@@
I think I'd like to leave now.

@@U00824@@
No, stay! Another moment! You'll see how splendidly swinish they can be! (西贝尔 drinks carelessly, spilling the wine on the floor that turns into flame.)

@@U00826@@
Help! Fire! Help! Hell’s on fire!

@@U00828@@
(To the flame.)

@@U00829@@
Peace, friendly element, down!

@@U00830@@
(To the DRINKERS.)

@@U00831@@
This time it was only a spark from Purgatory.

@@U00833@@
What’s all this? Just you wait! You'll pay! You'll pay dearly! I dare say you don't know who you're dealing with!

@@U00835@@
Don't try that again!

@@U00837@@
Let’s get rid of them on the sly.

@@U00839@@
How dare you, sir! How dare you play your monkey shenanigans on us!

@@U00841@@
Quiet, you old tub of lard!
translation:
@@U00822@@
我想我现在就想离开。

@@U00824@@
不，留下来！又一刻！你会发现它们是多么的猪气！ （西贝尔不小心喝了酒，酒洒在地板上，化成了火焰。）

@@U00826@@
救命啊！火！帮助！地狱着火了！

@@U00828@@
（走向火焰。）

@@U00829@@
和平友好元素，下来！

@@U00830@@
（致饮酒者。）

@@U00831@@
这一次只是炼狱中的火花。

@@U00833@@
这一切是什么？就等你了！你会付钱的！你会付出惨重的代价！我敢说你不知道你在和谁打交道！

@@U00835@@
不要再尝试了！

@@U00837@@
让我们偷偷地摆脱他们吧。

@@U00839@@
先生你怎么敢！你竟敢对我们玩猴子的把戏！

@@U00841@@
安静，你这个老猪油桶！
